integrity: The geometric source representation and its three-by-three spectra are not claimed as new. Only the exact random-width and sharp two-term rare-width law, together with the conditional orientation limits, are assessed here. Standalone numerical diagnostics are supporting evidence, not a substitute for proof.
limitations: Exactly the convex hull of the unit-normalized Steiner Roman surface, Euclidean caliper width and Haar-uniform viewing directions. Priority is provisional; dual eigenvalue and coordinate-product formulations may exist in additional literature.
title: Logarithmic rare-width localization of the Steiner Roman-surface hull
